I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; it's waiting in the mailbox for someone to review and send.

The draft's subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356 per-seat figure, says it came from Dana Okafor, and notes that Anselm cleared sharing it.

No other approval was needed. The rate is a finance figure, so it can only go to people outside Anselm, June and the account owner if one of them approves. Anselm is the CFO, so his go-ahead counts. Hollis is on pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail didn't apply.
